limitations: prototype only; production remains bound to the canonical zero-rotation rule
bounded evidence for retained seeds and named parameter rivals, not all seeds or hypotheses
the glyph tile is copied unchanged; only its decoded destination slot rotates

input_constraints: the selected canonical nine-tile grammar must pass self_check
all eight directional glyphs occur exactly once and the ninth tile is blank
all four parameter settings must produce distinct outputs on every retained pair
the same selected setting labels every demonstration and query in an episode

meaning.0: place each decoded glyph in its canonical compass slot
meaning.1: place each decoded glyph one compass quarter-turn clockwise
meaning.2: place each decoded glyph in the opposite compass slot
meaning.3: place each decoded glyph one compass quarter-turn counterclockwise

0.text:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define (solid-3x3? r c)
               (for*/and ((dr (range 0 3)) (dc (range 0 3)))
                         (!= (at g (+ r dr) (+ c dc)) 0)))
             (define tiles
               (for*/list ((r (range 0 (- h 2))) (c (range 0 (- w 2))) #:when (solid-3x3? r c))
                 (list r c)))
             (define (colored-cells tr tc)
               (for*/list ((dr (range 0 3)) (dc (range 0 3))
                   #:when
                   (!= (at g (+ tr dr) (+ tc dc)) 5))
                 (list dr dc)))
             (define (target-row cells)
               (let* ((rs (map first cells))
                      (lo (min-list rs))
                      (hi (max-list rs)))
                 (cond ((= hi 1) 0) ((= lo 1) 2) (else 1))))
             (define (target-col cells)
               (let* ((cs (map second cells))
                      (lo (min-list cs))
                      (hi (max-list cs)))
                 (cond ((= hi 1) 0) ((= lo 1) 2) (else 1))))
             (define (stamp-tile out tile)
               (let* ((tr (first tile))
                      (tc (second tile))
                      (cells (colored-cells tr tc)))
                 (if (empty? cells)
                     out
                     (let ((or (* 3 (target-row cells)))
                           (oc (* 3 (target-col cells))))
                       (for*/fold ((acc out))
                                  ((dr (range 0 3)) (dc (range 0 3)))
                                  (set-cell acc
                                            (+ or dr)
                                            (+ oc dc)
                                            (at g (+ tr dr) (+ tc dc))))))))
             (for/fold ((out (empty-grid 9 9 5))) ((tile tiles)) (stamp-tile out tile))))))
